name: 5561-specdecode-llama160m-1gpu
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 200 requests / 900 s safety.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: exactly 256 prompt tokens and exactly 128 output tokens on every request (min == max == the target on both), plain request format, temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0, and `ignore_eos` so every request emits its full 128 tokens. Deterministic prompt corpus via scenario.json `seed`.
purpose: A single-user drafting-accelerated chat assistant on one GPU, answering 256-token prompts with 128-token replies, one at a time.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.x V0 flat speculative arguments: the single `--speculative-config` blob does not exist
# here and an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction. Do not modernise this file, and
# run it in this engine's own venv.

model: JackFram/llama-160m

# The draft must share the target's vocab size (32000), which this engine requires of a pair.
speculative-model: JackFram/llama-68m

num-speculative-tokens: 5
speculative-draft-tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Required, not optional: speculative decoding on this engine asserts the v2 block manager, and
# the 0.5.x default is False -- leaving it out gives no run at all rather than a slower one.
use-v2-block-manager: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# 2048 is both checkpoints' `max_position_embeddings`, so it is the ceiling rather than a choice.
max-model-len: 2048

# Stated because it disagrees with the checkpoints: both config.json files say `torch_dtype:
# float32`, and `auto` on this engine casts them down to float16 anyway.
dtype: float16

# Engine defaults, written down so a later release default cannot silently move the setup.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-seqs: 256
block-size: 16
enable-chunked-prefill: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
